title: Oven Roasted Croatian Chicken Wings Skewers
description: A cultured Croatian dish featuring chicken wings, soffritto base, and a cheese pull, perfect for a weeknight dinner that is plant based friendly
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped onion, garlic, carrots, and celery to the bowl and toss to coat with the oil mixture.
Thread the chicken wings onto skewers, leaving a small space between each wing.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush with the oil mixture.
Roast the chicken in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
After 30 minutes, sprinkle the shredded vegan mozzarella over the chicken wings.
Return the chicken to the oven and roast for an additional 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the chicken from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
